tagline: AI agent projects and development portfolio

hero.headline_after: that make everyday tasks a little easier.
hero.description: During my internship I worked on a handful of AI agent projects — from a study planner to a meeting-notes assistant. This is a simple place to see what I built, what each project does, and what I learned along the way.

projects_section.description: Four projects I worked on during my internship. Each one is a small agent designed to help with a real, everyday task.

agents.title: Study Buddy Agent
agents.description: A friendly agent that helps students build study plans, break down assignments, and stay on track with reminders.
agents.detail_description: Study Buddy takes a class or assignment and turns it into a clear, day-by-day plan. It breaks big tasks into smaller steps, suggests how long each might take, and sends friendly reminders so nothing slips. The goal was to make studying feel less overwhelming and more manageable.
highlights: Turns one request into a day-by-day plan
Breaks big assignments into small steps
Sends reminders to keep students on track

agents.title: Finance Coach Agent
agents.description: An agent that explains personal finance in plain language — budgeting, saving, and simple trade-offs — without jargon.
agents.detail_description: Finance Coach helps make everyday money decisions more approachable by breaking down budgeting, savings goals, and simple financial questions into clear steps.

agents.title: Research Assistant Agent
agents.description: An agent that reads long articles and papers and returns short, organized summaries with the key points highlighted.
agents.detail_description: Research Assistant takes long-form research material and produces structured summaries to help readers find the important information faster.

agents.title: Meeting Notes Agent
agents.description: An agent that turns meeting audio into clean, organized notes with action items, so nothing important gets lost.
agents.detail_description: Meeting Notes processes recorded conversations and turns them into clear notes, useful summaries, and follow-up action items.
highlights: Converts spoken audio into useful notes

about.heading: About Me
about.intro: I'm Avik, a student interested in artificial intelligence, computer science, and finance. During my internship I got the chance to build AI agents from scratch — designing how they think, writing the code, and testing them with real tasks. I love turning ideas into small things that actually work.
about.interest_card_text: AI agents, software development, and how technology can help with personal finance.
about.build_card_text: I enjoy the feeling of making something useful out of an idea, and learning a lot along the way.
about.future_card_text: I want to keep building AI that's genuinely helpful, and keep growing as a developer.
about.work_text: During my internship, I built four AI agents. For each one I designed the conversation flow, wrote the logic, and connected it to the tools it needed — like speech-to-text or retrieval. I owned the projects end to end and tested them on real tasks to see what worked and what didn't.
learnings: How to turn a vague request into clear steps an agent can follow.
Designing agents that use tools and explain their reasoning.
Keeping summaries accurate with retrieval-augmented generation.
Turning messy real-world input (like audio) into useful structure.
